statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service is to detect arrhythmic events
The service is to guide anticoagulation management
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
